Muxers for the 3D's best-quality movie (web/app/movierender.js): they put
the frames the browser's own encoder (WebCodecs) makes into a file.

  mp4-muxer.mjs   mp4-muxer 5.2.2 (npm, build/mp4-muxer.mjs), MIT - LICENSE-mp4-muxer.txt
  webm-muxer.mjs  webm-muxer 5.1.4 (npm, build/webm-muxer.mjs), MIT - LICENSE-webm-muxer.txt

Both by Vanilagy, unchanged.  No network, no page access: they only
arrange bytes.
